Run backend + frontend in two terminals.

- Backend:
  - `cd backend`
  - `npm install`
  - `npm run dev` (starts on `http://localhost:3001`)

- Frontend:
  - `cd frontend`
  - `npm install`
  - `npm run dev` (Vite prints the URL, usually `http://localhost:5173`)

If you want to run tests:
- Backend: `cd backend && npm test`
- Frontend: `cd frontend && npm test`

Your browser is blocking the frontend → backend request (CORS), so `fetch()` fails and you see “Failed to fetch”.

I fixed this by enabling CORS in the backend and making the totals section show the error.

- Updated `backend/src/app.ts` to send `Access-Control-Allow-*` headers and handle `OPTIONS`.
- Updated `frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx` to display a totals error instead of staying on “Loading…”.

Restart both servers:

- `cd backend && npm run dev`
- `cd frontend && npm run dev`

Then reload the page and try again.
what is "Coupon code", that I can to test.

Use one of these coupon codes (case-insensitive):

- `SAVE100` → valid (100 THB off, requires cart subtotal ≥ 500 THB; the demo cart is 1,000 THB so it works)
- `EXPIRED` → rejected with “คูปองหมดอายุ”
- `WELCOME` → works once, then the second attempt is rejected with “คุณใช้สิทธิ์ครบแล้ว”
